name: Medicine Ball Wall Ball Shot
description: A powerful throwing movement where a medicine ball is caught from a squat, then thrown against a high wall target on the way up. This integrates lower body power with core transfer and upper body power. It is a staple CrossFit and conditioning movement.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Medicine Ball Wall Ball Shot in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Medicine Ball Wall Ball Shot.
steps: Step 1: Stand facing wall holding medicine ball at chest. Set a target high on wall.
Step 2: Descend into a full squat catching ball to chest.
Step 3: Drive out of squat and throw ball to target using full body extension.
Step 4: Catch returning ball in slight squat and immediately repeat.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
common_mistakes: Throwing with arms only instead of legs
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Drive through heels and extend hips fully
